generatedProse.concept-context: In psychology, rigour is judged across the whole arc of a project. Examiners look for a clear line from the research questions, through a method the ethics committee approved, to the analysis the dissertation reports. A psychology dissertation is where this coherence is tested most searchingly, because it draws together design, ethics, data handling and reporting on a larger scale than any earlier assignment.
generatedProse.worked-example:
Two psychology students reach the final weeks of the same dissertation on memory and sleep.

Tom treated each stage as a separate box to tick. The proposal promised an experiment, the data was gathered through an online survey instead, and the ethics approval no longer matches what happened. The write-up is polished, but the gaps between what was proposed, approved and done are visible to any careful reader.

Amara kept the thread intact. The questions set in her proposal, the method approved by the ethics committee, and the analysis reported in her dissertation all line up, and every departure is explained with reasons. The work can be defended at each step because its integrity was sustained throughout, not assembled at the end.

Both submitted a dissertation. Only Amara could show that rigour held from proposal to submission, which is what the psychology dissertation, as the ultimate test of these competencies, is built to reveal.
generatedProse.summary: Rigour in psychology is not a stage but a thread that runs from proposal to dissertation. You can now articulate how integrity, transparency and accountability are sustained, evaluate whether a project holds together across its stages, and defend the decisions that keep research rigorous. The dissertation is where that sustained integrity is finally tested.

check.body: What is the clearest sign that a psychology project has upheld rigour from proposal to dissertation?

items.text: The questions, methods and findings line up across the stages, and any departure from the plan is explained with reasons.
The dissertation is longer than the proposal required.
The proposal and the dissertation describe completely different studies.
No one was able to question the methods used.

feedback.correct: That's right. Rigour shows as coherence across the stages, with any departure explained.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. What links the proposal, the method and the findings?
feedback.incorrectFinal: Rigour shows when the questions, methods and findings line up and changes are explained; length, divergence or avoiding scrutiny do not show it.
